why: Here Moab and Judah mean the tribe or people and its land, not the ancestor of that name.

In 2:16 the text says "The LORD's Spirit". Many Christians read this as the Holy Spirit, while Jewish readers take it as God's own spirit or power; the verse itself does not use that name. Bible Atlas's Jordan point is near the river's sources in the far north, but Elijah and Elisha cross it near Jericho, so no dot is drawn.

In 3:8-26 the chapter names Edom, the land and its people, not Esau himself; Bible Atlas links Esau because Edom descends from him. Here Judah and Moab mean the tribe or people and its land, not the ancestor of that name.
Elijah does not appear in this chapter; it tells of Elisha and Naaman. Here Ephraim means the tribe or people and its land, not the ancestor of that name.

In 8:20-22 the chapter names Edom, the land and its people, not Esau himself; Bible Atlas links Esau because Edom descends from him. Here Israel and Judah mean the tribe or people and its land, not the ancestor of that name.
Here Judah means the tribe or people and its land, not the ancestor of that name.

In 10:29, where the golden calves stood Dan is the northern city, which is linked separately as a place, not Jacob's son Dan or his tribe. Here Judah means the tribe or people and its land, not the ancestor of that name.

12:21 names Jehozabad's father Shomer. Bible Atlas links Shimrith, whom 2 Chronicles 24:26 names as his mother, so that link rests on reading the two passages together. Here Judah means the tribe or people and its land, not the ancestor of that name.
Here Judah means the tribe or people and its land, not the ancestor of that name.

In 14:7 and 14:10 the chapter names Edom, the land and its people, not Esau himself; Bible Atlas links Esau because Edom descends from him. In 14:13 Ephraim is only part of the name of a Jerusalem gate, which is linked as a place. Here Judah means the tribe or people and its land, not the ancestor of that name.
Here Judah and Naphtali mean the tribe or people and its land, not the ancestor of that name.
